title: and heartily recommend it. It fit on hairdryers in 3 different ...
text: I have always packed my hairdryer and diffuser on trips, and looked for another solution before an overseas trip because buying a transformer and adapter was going to be expensive - and I still wasn't sure it would work. I got this, and heartily recommend it. It fit on hairdryers in 3 different hotels - one of them was kind of wide but the material on this diffuser is forgiving enough that I was able to stretch it around that one too. I will now pack this instead of my hairdryer even for quick domestic trips, what a nifty travel solution. And I have curly hair and am kind of picky about my diffuser - this is sturdy (even though it's collapsible) and full size.

title: I did NOT get this diffuser for free and I like it as well.
text: I did NOT get this product free. I paid for it. I tried a few universal diffusers and think this one is pretty good. It would've been excellent if the prongs would not stick out at all out of the edges (they do less so than most universal diffusers but I prefer them all the way in to create perfect curls). It did a good job overall and I was satisfied with results and am keeping it. Besides doing a good job on my curls, it's lightweight, obviously very portable and does fit my blowdryer nicely.

title: Does the job but collapses too easily
text: Ok. Here's the thing. I WANT to leave a fantastic review for this. I really do. The company sent me emails with helpful tips and even responded with suggestions when I complained. They have been great. And it really does help my frizzy, flyaway thick curly hair! However... it collapses. Every, Single. Time. I've tried everything. The company suggested I pull it up further on the dryer. Didn't help. So, I do use it. And I love the results. But it's a huge pain in the butt to constantly pull back out every few seconds. They need a new design. :-/ It also arrived with a little black piece broken off and floating around inside of it. No idea if this piece is important or not.

title: DOES NOT FIT
text: It's supposed to be flexible and fit "most hair dryers" but it did not fit my ProAir 1875, which has a 2 3/8" opening -- just a little bigger than the diffuser's advertised opening. When I tried to pull the rubber of the diffuser over the dryer nozzle, the rubber ripped, and now I'm out the money. For four dollars more, I could have bought the ProAir 1875 with a diffuser -- which is exactly what I did today.

title: Keeps curly beautiful, adapts to any dryer
text: I've found that it's increasingly difficult to find a blow dryer that includes a diffuser. I was very pleased to find this diffuser that fit on my new hair dryer, and stays on! The fact that it's collapsible is an added bonus, as I travel quite a bit, and diffuser usually takes up quite a bit of space. This diffuser helps save space when traveling, and I haven't had an issue with it collapsing while I'm using it. Best of all is that it keeps my curls looking great!

title: Good, but not blown away
text: This is a good product. it actually fits my Sedu 4000i, which is a big plus. Also love that it collapses to store. I have thick curly hair (3A and 3B), and so i was excited to try this. So far i am having two issues. One, it tends to collapse to smaller size during use, esp when i get it closer to my head. Not sure that's a good thing. Two, and this may be an issue of me not using it properly, it seems to make my hair too curly! I like having the longer thicker big curls, rather than the tighter smaller and collier curls - and when i air dry, i usually have big thick curls. But with this diffuser, i end up with smaller tighter curls, which is not exactly what i want.

title: This Diffuser Works Wonders!
text: I don't have the curliest hair, but this diffuser has done serious wonders for these locks! Seriously. It is so easy to slip on my blow dryer, and it stays put! My hair was dry in no time with next to NO frizz! I cannot tell you how happy that makes me!! Plus I loved that little Curly Co. Guide - so cute and such helpful tips! Can't wait to get more Curly Co. products! #frizzfreelife

title: What a DISAPPOINTMENT

title: Great Diffuser
text: This is the best diffuser. My curls have never been to shiny and manageable. Fit my dryer perfectly. Love the way it is soft enough to angle as you use it making holding the dryer around my head very easy. Love it.

title: Best diffuser I've ever used!!!
text: I never thought I could love a diffuser so much, but this one makes me fall in love with it every single time I use it! It's easy to use, easy to put on my blow dryer, and - best of all - easy to store! I have a small bathroom, so storage is super important. This diffuser gives me gorgeous hair without the huge bulky attachments that I used to have to deal with! The Curly Co. diffuser is seriously amazing.

title: Fell apart after just a couple of times using !!!
text: I bought this diffuser and after using just a couple of times it completely fell apart. The rubber at the connection point started tearing and the filter would not stay on. Very dissatisfied. title: Works well, stays on the blow dryer without falling off.
text: So far I am enjoying the Curly Co. collapsible diffuser. The diffusers that come with blow dryers always seemed to fall off, and they took up so much space in the drawer. This fits nicely on my hair dryer and collapses when I want to store it, and I don't even remove it from the dryer. The diffuser works well and my hair seems to be fluffier ,with defined curls, which is always my goal. I look forward to being able to take this with me when I travel, so that is a nice bonus.

title: DO NOT RECOMMEND!

title: Highly recommend for travel or home!
text: So glad I bought this collapsible diffuser! It flattens out well and easily slides into tiny spaces in my suitcase, it's sturdy enough that it doesn't collapse while being used, and it fits snugly around oval and round shaped hair dryer ends. It's my new go-to for on the road and quickly gives my wavy hair great results! No more shoving a giant hair dryer plus its hard plastic diffuser into an overpacked suitcase. No more having to leave stuff home or bring an extra bag ($ less cha-ching for airline fees $). It's my new best travel buddy. Highly recommend! *Photo is of round-ended hotel hair dryer.

title: All the reason why I love it!
text: Love so many things about this diffuser! text: I have never bought and used a diffuser in my life. I have had hair stylists use them on my hair. This thing was great! It fit on my Conair hairdyer (which has a 2 inch nozzle). title: AWESOME!
text: Loved the results! I normally use the deva curl one but this one got my hair dryer quicker and left such a soft, shiny bouncy results!!

title: I love the way this made my hair not as frizzy
text: I love the way this made my hair not as frizzy!!! The o my downside is when it gets hot it does tend to collapse a little bit not a huge issue.... All in all it's pretty good!!!! ****

title: Happily surprised!
text: I love this diffuser! It fit the end of my professional dryer and is so light weight! As a professional stylist of 39 years and having used many diffusers over the years I found this one to be good quality, lightweight and had a good fit for my dryer while others I have used have been heavy and bulky. I definitely would recommend this to my clients! The only reason I couldn’t give it 5 stars is that it can get hot. My personal recommendation for that is start with heat and as it starts to get very warm switch to the cool air cycle on your dryer and problem solved! My curls have never looked better! Thanks to The Curly.Co for a great product!

title: Fell Apart After Four Months Use
text: Purchased less than four months ago and already it has fallen apart (see photo). So why am I buying another one? Well, my wife likes the way it works, the way it travels and the fact that it fits her hair drier perfectly. And you know the old saying, "Happy wife, happy life." And it does make her hair look terrific. This time she'll be more careful when removing it and try not to remove it when it's hot. She will also pull it off by the sleeve and not the diffuser itself. title: Ripped after a Year
text: Was enjoying this product- especially for travel. It was recommended to me by my hair stylist. It does collapse on you a bit while drying but the ability to store it easily made it worth it to me. I’ve probably used it about 50 times. Today, I smelled a burning smell and looked down and the whole base had ripped. I’m pretty disappointed because this curly girl had to leave the house with a wet head and I’m just not sure if I should get another one…

title: ... have only used this a couple times but I love it. My hair dryer has a very small ...
text: I have only used this a couple times but I love it. My hair dryer has a very small nozzle and I was worried how this would fit. Most of the diffusers out there are too large. It takes up a lot less space compared to other diffusers. I can take my hair from straight to curly very easily. The company also gave tips on how to achieve great curls. I would recommend!

title: This does not fit a standard American hairdryer
text: I’m kind of shocked at the reviews and question whether they’re real. I received this diffuser a few days ago. I primarily bought it to use in hotel rooms when I travel. I tried it out on my hairdryers at home. I own a Babyliss and the Dyson dryer. I don’t really need it for home but it couldn’t fit over the nozzle of either dryer. I also tried it on my daughters Dry bar hairdryer. It didn’t fit. I am currently staying in a hotel and it has a standard full size wall dryer and it doesn’t fit at all. I’ve attached pictures for size. I only bought this diffuser based on the reviews. This must only fit on a mini dryer. That’s all I can think of. Can’t report on how it works since I can’t use it.

title: That the product did what it was advertised to do
text: I was so excited because I follow this product on instagram and I thought it would enhance my curls and also the self collapsing feature for traveling was very cool. Firstly, I struggled for some time to even get the diffuser onto my blow dryer. I have basic Conair blow dryer and have never had an issue with any other diffuser before. I finally got the diffuser onto the end and thought well if this did a good job I wouldn't mind a little struggle, but it didn't. It not only kept collapsing to one side but it blow out my curls causing them to separate and become freezy. after a good 15 mins I stopped and switched back to my original diffuser.

title: The diffuser packs easily. It is not as good as a standard ...
text: The diffuser packs easily. It is not as good as a standard one but works reasonably well for a travel solution. The two detractions are 1) that it does not fit many dryers, particularly a number made by Conair. I ended up having to buy a new travel dryer to go with it (Revlon makes one that fits) and 2) it collapses while being used but it works when it's not extended . Bottom line: not perfect but a good solution for those who pack light.

title: Big effort to fit on dryer, but well worth it!
text: When I first got this I immediately decided I would have to return it. While it might be "constructed to adapt to most any model of hair dryer", of course I have a model of hair dryer that it doesn't fit, at least not without a lot of fighting. However, I finally got it wedged onto my hair dryer enough to use it, and I'm so glad I did, because I was thrilled with it after that! It's very soft on the edge, and it sort of bends and moves around, so you can move it all around your head and it doesn't hurt like a hard plastic diffuser would, plus it moves and contours to shape against your head.

title: Great travel companion!
text: I purchased this for travel after I burned a hole in my mesh fabric ion diffuser. I liked the fabric one because it was the size of a sock, easy to pack, and the elastic neck could fit any size dryer nozzle. BUT, if you don't maintain enough distance between the end of the nozzle and the mesh, it burns! So, I bought is collapsible style for a change and it's awesome! My hair dries quicker than the fabric style, and it's much closer to the diffuser I use daily at home.

title: Perfect travel companion for curly ladies
text: This diffuser is a great find. It's compact and lightweight, so perfect for travel. I've taken it on two trips so far, and had no problem using it with the hotel-provided hairdryer. I don't get quite as good results as I do with my larger diffuser/dryer set up at home, but it's better than not having a diffuser when traveling or trying to pack my everyday diffuser and hairdryer. I didn't have a problem with it collapsing while I was using it. I don't press the diffuser into my head; I just hold it right up to the curls. Overall, this is a great travel tool and a good value.

title: Miracle for Travelling Curly-heads
text: Travelled all over with this diffuser. One hotel's hair dryer was broken at the tip and required quite a bit of fight to get it on, but everywhere else it worked like a champ. Will never travel without this!

title: Works great for me!
text: I love this product! I travel often, and I’m always freaking out that the plastic diffuser that came with my dryer will get broken during transit leaving me to deal with bad hair for my entire trip. This diffuser fits snugly on my dryer, even with my dryer’s somewhat oddly shaped end. There is no struggle to put it on or get it off. I simply put the collapsed diffuser down on a flat surface (typically the bed) and press my dryer into the end. I do not have any issues with it collapsing during use. I actually get more air flow with this one versus the one that my dryer came with giving me a faster dry without sacrificing any curls. A very satisfying purchase!

title: makes sense, and worth it!!!
text: i gotta, say, before buying this i saw all the other reviews saying how terrible it was being flimsy. well, i'll admit it's not the sturdiest of diffusers BUT, you gotta consider the fact that it IS made out of silicone AND collapsible. those two combined are not necessarily the strongest. THAT BEING SAID, i dont have a problem with it because i'm not pressing my diffuser up to my scalp to let it do its job. only if your roughly diffusing (which i don't know why that's necessary) will you have a problem with the flimsiness. in all honesty, i don't think its weak at all. it's great for travel, does the job, and very well made. a very good purchase in my opinion.

title: Great product, but starting to fall apart!
text: I really like this diffuser, it works great and collapses down nicely for travel. I have found that I'm using less product in my hair, which is a bonus because it takes less time to dry in the morning! The one drawback that I've noticed is that the top part tends to detach, and the center pin has fallen out. I've used this diffuser less than 20 times so far, and that makes me concerned about how it will hold up over the long run.

title: Perfect diffuser to pack / travel!
text: Love love love this diffuser. I have fine naturally curly hair which does not air dry well. (hello frizz). So I have to use a diffuser, which means when I travel I typically had to stuff a big bulky item into my suitcase. With the newer smaller carry on suitcases, this was becoming a problem. I stumbled on this when looking for collapsible diffusers and I LOVE it. I used it on my smaller bliss travel hair dryer. Some reviews have noted that it can fall off the hairdryer due to a looser fit. This can be true (definitely on the travel dryer), but since I don't usually flip this upside where it would fall off, it's not a problem.

title: Fits and Works
text: At first, I thought this was too small to fit my dryer. I tried repeatedly to pull it onto the barrel because I really wanted it to work. Then it occurred to me that maybe it could be pushed on. By removing the diffuser piece (snaps out easily), I could push it onto the barrel until it was very secure. My dryer barrel is 2.25 inches in diameter. This diffuser works so much better than my old one; note the design of the diffuser piece. It disperses warm air evenly without creating frizz. I can finally use a dryer instead of simply air-drying…which takes sooo long with curly hair.

title: Good for travel but not especially sturdy
text: This diffuser is lightweight and only 1.75" tall when collapsed. And the part that slips over the dryer nozzle stretches ever-so-slightly to accommodate my Conair Vagabond, which has a non-tapering barrel and 2" mouth. I don't mind that half the vents in little circular piece (in the center of the "bell") are blocked by plastic; it's a minor flaw. But it gets annoying when the diffuser keeps collapsing, partially or fully, with little pressure when I'm drying my hair. Despite the collapse issue, I bought a second diffuser about a year ago to use at home. It was better than the bulky plastic "universal" one that kept falling off my full-size dryer.

title: It doesn't work, don't buy it!
text: Worst invention ever! This got returned to Amazon 30sec after trying it. The attachment part has to be forcefully stretched over hair dryer nosel. it pops off a lot and the silicon gets so hot that you can't even try to put back on until it cools down . The worst is that it collapses as you try to use it! Seriously! It has no weight to the product so can't use on roots /scalp. It's just completely worthless.

title: Gets the job done - good for travel
text: I almost didn’t buy this because of the mixed reviews, but I did, so after using it on two trips, I thought I’d leave my take on it... 1) it fit both hotel hairdryers - one was much much more difficult to get the diffuser on, but it did go on both. 2) yes, it will collapse if you use too much pressure. I’ve got a lot of hair. So on the dryer that it was harder to put on - it collapsed pretty easily. I used two hands and it got the job done. Basically - it’s lightweight, compact and got my curls dry when I need it to. Would I use it regularly at home? Nope. Would I keep packing it on trips? Yep.

title: I honestly wasn't 100% sure that I would love it. It has absolutely exceeded ALL of my ...
text: When I ordered this diffuser, I honestly wasn't 100% sure that I would love it. It has absolutely exceeded ALL of my expectations! I couldn't be more in love with it now! I needed a diffuser that would be easy to store in my small bathroom and just as easy to take with me when I travel. This one fits the bill. I've never gotten such great results from a hair diffuser before! Can't wait to see what other products The Curly Co. comes up with! - Russell's wife :)

title: Alright I guess
text: It does the job of drying your hair with minimal heat if you keep your hand on the cool setting and I do notice less frizz with it, but if you have short to medium hair it can be a pain to use and the collapsable element is great if you're packing it to take somewhere but annoying when it collapses while you are trying to dry your hair. For the price it's probably about as good as you're going to get, but I would personally spend a little more on a more efficient diffuser.

title: Volume, definition, without lots of product - multiple days of fabulous looking wavy hair!
